results.title: Arsenal snatch Liverpool wonderkid! Gunners beat Man Utd and Chelsea to signature of England youth star Vincent Joseph
results.description: Arsenal have officially confirmed the signing of 16-year-old forward Joseph from Liverpool. The teenager joins the north London club as part of their first-year scholarship intake ahead of the 2026/27 campaign.
